lore.label: Lore
lore.description: Text lines below the item name (MiniMessage, e.g. '<'gray>).

unbreakable.label: Unbreakable
unbreakable.description: The item does not lose durability.

excludeFromInventory.label: Exclude From Inventory
excludeFromInventory.description: The item does not appear in /nexo inventory but can still be given with /nexo give.

excludeFromCommands.label: Exclude From Commands
excludeFromCommands.description: The item does not show up in command completion (e.g. for helper items).

template.label: Template
template.description: Inherits all properties of other Nexo items.

field.label: Template item IDs
field.help: Several templates are merged in order. Nexo 1.30 reads them all from template (the docs call the list templates).

itemFlags.label: ItemFlags
itemFlags.description: Hides parts of the tooltip. From 1.21.5 on, prefer the “Tooltip Display” component.

persistentData.label: PersistentData
persistentData.description: Custom data in the item''s PersistentDataContainer (PublicBukkitValues).

customname.label: Custom Name
customname.description: A name shown like a rename on an anvil (italic unless formatted).

field.label: Name
field.help: Read by Nexo 1.30, not listed in the docs.

injectId.label: Inject ID
injectId.description: Off: the item is not registered as a Nexo item (for helper items such as Carpentry door halves).

field.label: Register as Nexo item
field.help: Read by Nexo 1.30, not listed in the docs.

noAutoUpdate.label: No Auto Update
noAutoUpdate.description: Nexo does not update existing copies of the item after a config change.

field.label: Skip automatic updates
field.help: Read by Nexo 1.30, not listed in the docs.
